page_title: BRE 1-3 MCI | Brentford v Manchester City 05/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Jarred Gillett has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Now Brentford have a corner.
90+3' Nathan Ake (Manchester City) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
90+1' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Neal Maupay will be replaced by Shandon Baptiste (Brentford).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
86' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Erling Haaland as he is replaced by Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
86' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
85' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
84' 29:71 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
79' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) replacing Sergio Reguilon.
78' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
78' The ball is out of play and Brentford manage to earn a corner.
77' Substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) on for Mathias Jensen.
76' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Vitaly Janelt is replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) comes onto the pitch so that Mads Roerslev Rasmussen can be given a rest.
76' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City).
75' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Manchester City.
71' Substitution. Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) replaces Bernardo Silva.
70' 1 - 3 Goal - 1:3! Erling Haaland laid the ball off to Phil Foden (Manchester City), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
67' Ivan Toney (Brentford) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
66' Total attempts – 7:22.
63' Neal Maupay (Brentford) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
63' The resulting corner from Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
62' Brentford get a corner.
62' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
60' Manchester City take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
59' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester City.
58' Manchester City are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

57' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Mark Flekken easily catches the ball.
56' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.

53' 1 - 2 A perfect lofted pass from Kevin De Bruyne finds Phil Foden (Manchester City), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom right corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Mark Flekken had no chance of stopping that. 1:2.
51' Ivan Toney (Brentford) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
50' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
49' Poor challenge! Ruben Dias (Manchester City) is penalised for tripping and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle.
49' Rodri (Manchester City) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
47' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Phil Foden (Manchester City) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
45+3' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45+1' A quickly taken corner by Manchester City.
45+1' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
45+1' Manchester City earn a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
45' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
44' Phil Foden (Manchester City) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Mark Flekken.
42' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
41' The Manchester City players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
40' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
39' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ederson intercepts the ball.
39' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Sergio Reguilon (Brentford).
38' Ivan Toney (Brentford) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Brentford will take a corner kick.
38' Brentford force their opponents to concede a corner.
36' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is able to continue to play.
35' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
34' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
33' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:12.
33' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
32' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
31' Neal Maupay (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.
27' The resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared by the defence.

27' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Mark Flekken pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
26' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Brentford was in an offside position.

24' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the bottom right corner, Mark Flekken didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.

24' What a wasted opportunity by Erling Haaland (Manchester City)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
23' Phil Foden (Manchester City) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
22' The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Neal Maupay (Brentford) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 1:0.
20' A rebound falls kindly for Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
20' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
19' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
18' Ball possession – 27:73.
15' Manchester City fail to score from a corner as Mark Flekken (Brentford) leaps to collect the ball.
15' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Mark Flekken easily deals with the threat.
14' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

14' A sweet pass finds Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Mark Flekken is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
13' Ivan Toney (Brentford) is adjudged offside.
12' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
12' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) takes the corner but it's cleared.

11' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Good work from Manchester City as they win a corner.
11' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
10' A snap shot by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) from the edge of the area flies towards the top right corner, but Mark Flekken produces a good reflex save to thwart him.
7' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Erling Haaland (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
5' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
3' Neal Maupay (Brentford) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Phil Foden (Manchester City).
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Manchester City will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett is the one to supervise the game today.
